Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionExplore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game. An enigmatic cataclysm has fractured reality, opening portals which lead to other times. Explore the past and future versions of an expansive city. Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes, traveling back and forth through time to make architecture whole again. Challenge your spatial thinking by navigating impossible architecture, as reality distorts and time becomes increasingly unstable. Activate holograms to move massive portals between floors of crumbled cathedrals, allowing you to traverse structures which only partially exist in one time. Partner with the city's guardian to prevent a cataclysm which threatens to merge past and future. Save the City of Desolus from annihilation.Show morePublished byThe Quantum Astrophysicists GuildDeveloped byMark J. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionUnleash pure chaos as a furious rabbit in this fast-paced comedic brawler with roguelike elements! Fight through waves of quirky enemies, unlock absurd upgrades, and experiment with wild abilities that change every run. Smash, spin, and explode your way through vibrant, comic-style arenas where every battle is unpredictable, over-the-top, and packed with humor. Key features: - Chaotic Beat’em Up Combat: Dive into fast-paced, over-the-top battles where every hit is packed with comic-style effects and exaggerated action. - Roguelike Progression: Each run is different - choose between random upgrades, stack crazy abilities, and create unique builds every time you play. - Absurd Weapons & Skills: Use ridiculous abilities like spinning ear attacks, explosive carrots, and powerful charge strikes to wipe out enemies in style. - Dynamic Enemy Waves: Face growing hordes of enemies that become faster and stronger, forcing you to adapt and survive as long as possible. - Vibrant Comic World: Fight across colorful, stylized arenas that feel like living comic panels, filled with humor, chaos, and visual punch.
